breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly provided the temperature difference formulas for a parallel-flow exchanger while asking for a counterflow design. The agent used the incorrect parallel-flow formulas (`ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in` and `ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out`) in its calculation, instead of correcting them to the proper counterflow formulas (`ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out` and `ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in`) as specified in the ground truth.
